messages:
anya: Quick sync — trying to onboard zephyr-13b. Origin manifest points at huggingface://zephyr/zephyr-13b but the registry entry is missing weights. When I try to load the tokenizer I get a vocab mismatch error. Can someone confirm source & access?

anya: Error snippet: ```RuntimeError: tokenizer vocab size mismatch: expected 50257, found 50256 (tokenizer.json)```

tj: I saw that before — last time it was an extra <bos> token added by an older tokenizer export. If origin tokenizer.json includes 'add_bos': true we strip it for serving. Check tokenizer config at the HF repo.

sam: I can kick off a copy to the registry but need read access to huggingface path or a presigned archive. Is the HF repo public? If private, we need a service token. Also want the SHA256 of the weights tar so I can validate after transfer.

anya: HF repo is public but the model owner published two tokenizer variants. The manifest currently points to the v2-tokenizer. Maybe the mismatch is due to that. I added the HF path: https://huggingface.co/zephyr/zephyr-13b/tree/main (see tokenizer.json and merges.txt)

mike: FYI our default onboarding config in ci/onboard.yaml has `weights_source: registry` which will fail until mirror exists. Suggest switching to `weights_source: origin` for the initial smoke run, then flip to registry after mirror and checksum validation. I'll open a quick PR for the CI toggle.

sam: Ok I'll run a one-off mirror. Command I will use: ```aws s3 cp s3://hf-staging/zephyr-13b/weights.tar.gz s3://redwood-registry/zephyr-13b/weights.tar.gz --acl bucket-owner-full-control``` Will compute SHA256 locally: `sha256sum weights.tar.gz` and post it here.

deploy-bot: Mirror job queued by sam — job-id 64721.

ops-bot: Mirror job started: job-id 64721, started by sam at 2026-03-17T12:45:00Z.

ops-bot: Mirror job completed: job-id 64721, status=success, size=19.2GB, objects=42, duration=00:07:34. SHA256: 9b1f4c3a8d5e2a1f6c7b2d9e0f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1

anya: Great — thanks. I updated onboarding manifest to point to registry path s3://redwood-registry/zephyr-13b/weights.tar.gz and changed tokenizer source to `origin` temporarily in the config. Running smoke now.

tj: Heads up — if smoke passes, we should also add an automated tokenizer sanity check in registry ingestion: verify tokenizer.vocab_size matches model embedding matrix dim and check for BOS/CLS token presence. I can sketch a small checker in ~30m.

mike: PR #2345 opened to flip CI toggle and add a short note in onboard README. @sam can you review?

sam: Reviewing now. Quick note: when you flip to registry by default we'll enable checksum enforcement in registry metadata so future pusher jobs will reject mismatched uploads.

anya: Awesome. After smoke I'll run a small eval to compare decoding between origin tokenizer and registry tokenizer and report diffs. If we see off-by-one differences we'll standardize to origin tokenizer and store a normalized copy in registry.

tj: Good plan. If anyone hits permission issues for the next mirror runs ping infra-ops and include the job-id.

anya: Thanks team — I'll post results here in ~30m. :thumbsup:
